settings.breed_blurb: Tiny, fluffy and impossibly cute — Pomeranians are natural fashionistas who look adorable in every Petaloons creation.
settings.tip_lehenga: Mini lehengas in XS look absolutely magical on a Pomeranian's fluffy frame. Choose light fabrics that won't mat their coat.
settings.tip_sherwani: Tiny embroidered sherwanis in XS with a loose neck fitting look incredibly regal on a Pomeranian. A true show-stopper.
settings.tip_tshirt: XS sleeveless or short-sleeve tees are ideal so they don't weigh down or tangle the Pomeranian's thick double coat.
settings.tip_colours: Pure white, baby pink, lavender and gold look spectacular against the Pomeranian's fluffy orange, white or sable coat.
